writers.classification: Select and allocate replacement equipment, submit cash cost, publish output, then extract original equipment and physical material unless using pouch material.

writers.classification: Allocate/dispose templates for base modifiers, material names, superior-plan requirements and modified-item descriptions. These are probes, not player-owned enhancement inputs.

writers.classification: Mutate existing item affects and enhanced flag, submit cost, and extract the physical enhancement material; description probes are separate.
writers.authority_boundary: Preserve original item identity and exact payload delta, linking material retirement and payment. Do not classify in-place improvement as new equipment issuance.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Create an item on a newly materialized seasonal mobile before room placement.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: After eligible NPC-death selection, allocate at most one chosen essence and place it on the dying NPC, with killer/pet-master attribution used for reporting.

writers.classification: Allocate templates across the configured range, filter unsupported candidates, copy index metadata and discard each temporary object including failures.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: When configured and a NPC item reset is skipped, derive a high-quality material from the missing item and publish a newly allocated material to the mobile.

writers.classification: Count matching carried objects, then unlink and extract the requested number; artifact extraction is logged. Caller selects by template, but consumption acts on concrete instances.

writers.classification: Allocate an orb, consume the configured soul-shard count and publish the orb.
writers.authority_boundary: Link exact input UIDs and output admission, preserving the exchange outcome across allocation/payment/publication failure.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Consume faerie dust when refreshing eligible detection affects or adding detection to an existing sight effect.

writers.classification: Three ingredient-consumption calls occur after the unconditional disabled-command return. They are dormant source, not active item retirement; reactivation must link exact inputs to the character transformation.

writers.classification: Consume a set of scientific tools while adjusting salvage recipe chance/protection. Retain exact tool identity and the original salvage outcome; protection and chance changes do not create a second consumable grant.

writers.classification: Submit a provisional salvage output through item creation; refusal extracts the unadmitted candidate and returns false.

writers.classification: Allocate and submit two lower-quality materials, then unlink/extract the higher-quality input. The two grant return values do not gate input destruction.

writers.classification: Failed skill or poor-quality random outcome destroys the input without usable output, subject to scientific-tool protection policy.
writers.authority_boundary: Persist the original intended gameplay outcome and consumed UID; retries must neither reroll breakage nor treat storage failure as this gameplay loss.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Generate optional luck essence and guaranteed magical-item essence, one or two materials with rolled sale costs, and an eligible recipe scroll with target payload; finally extract the original item. Output submissions are separate and can fail independently.
writers.authority_boundary: Group input retirement, tools and every retained rolled output under one salvage identity. Item cost is payload, not wallet issuance. Recipe payload must retain target identity; partial success is not a complete salvage operation.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Materialize and place doors, boards, heartstone, window, fountain, bank counter, town portal and library tome from hall configuration. Payload links hall identity or destinations; placement differs by racewar.
writers.authority_boundary: Define explicit nontransferable representation policy backed by object data; do not mint economic fixtures on every init. Any transferable object needs first-admission identity independent of recycled room/VNUM.

writers.classification: After loading each configured golem, zero all denominations before room placement and set guild/racewar metadata.
writers.authority_boundary: Template cash is provisional until the documented admission boundary. Zeroing before publication is not retirement of already-admitted wallet value; do not invent durable mobile identity from pointer/runtime slot.

writers.classification: Older room teardown unlinks fixture objects and clears member pointers without extracting those objects; entrance teardown separately extracts golems. Workshop matching-prop extraction is a different existing route.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Publishes all four committed wallet denominations and revision, then GMCP; older revisions are ignored. This is a projection, not a second value event.
writers.authority_boundary: Committed result revision; native save acknowledgement and retained publication obligations remain separate integration requirements.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Builds a wallet endpoint before/after vector with checked denomination bounds and current revisions. No currency is mutated or submitted here.
writers.authority_boundary: Endpoint plan belongs to the containing transfer operation; generated builder identity alone does not prove committed transfer.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Builds a coin transfer command, checks endpoint fences and wallet availability, retains callback context, and submits to the coordinator. Attached results attempt publication.
writers.authority_boundary: Submission acceptance is not commit or durable publication acknowledgement; preserve the containing transfer identity through recovery.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Generic and identified wallet/bank submission construct typed deltas and revisions, then retain pending callback context and submit. Rebasable bank rewards use the designated revision sentinel. Prepared submission returns true for an already pending ID without comparing the incoming payload at that shortcut.
writers.authority_boundary: Caller determines the economic reason and counterpart; accepted queue admission is not completion. Same-ID changed intent and publication retention need integration qualification.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Converts a signed wallet value into denomination deltas and delegates to generic submission; no separate issuance or expense occurs in the adapter.
writers.authority_boundary: The caller operation owns provenance, source or sink and original identity; command construction is not commit.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Encodes a currency payload and assigns player/account keys and expected revisions under the supplied operation ID. The constructed command has no admission timestamp and does not mutate balances.
writers.authority_boundary: Caller-owned operation and backend transaction determine commit; builder success is not economic delivery.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Validates distinct source/destination identities and conserved copper value; checks wallet deltas and pile UID, payload and topology. Derives endpoint command IDs from the parent operation and endpoint index. Decode reconstructs the canonical command for comparison without applying it.
writers.authority_boundary: One parent transfer owns both endpoints. Child encoding and decoder reconstruction are not separately admitted issuance or destruction.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Advances destination bank or custody revisions when shared with the executed source endpoint, rebuilding an item command while preserving its operation ID and admission timestamp. This adjusts a command plan rather than publishing a pile or wallet.
writers.authority_boundary: Source result advances only matching revision domains within the containing transfer; atomic backend execution and replay qualification remain separate.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Periodic depletion or the last reserved charge extracts the mine object; last-charge extraction precedes completion of the harvest event.
writers.authority_boundary: Mine fixture/resource policy and lifetime required; extraction is not proof of a successful harvest or wallet sink.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Mounted fumble unequips the existing pick into the same player inventory and aborts the attempt.
writers.authority_boundary: Preserve pick UID and equipment-to-inventory topology; no new item is issued.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Allocates a mine, rejects and disposes it if placement search fails, otherwise rolls capacity/quality and publishes it in a room.
writers.authority_boundary: Explicit fixture/resource representation and generation identity; rejected provisional mine is not destruction of an admitted holding.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Trusted purge extracts matching room mines by type and configured region; reset invokes purge before replacement loading.
writers.authority_boundary: Retire identified mine lifetimes if tracked; retain operator provenance and distinguish reset replacement from player harvest.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Zeros template cash on a newly allocated guardian before room placement.
writers.authority_boundary: Provisional NPC initialization; do not invent a durable wallet or post-admission sink from template cash.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Zeros template cash on a newly allocated sage before room placement.
writers.authority_boundary: Provisional NPC initialization requires actual lifetime/admission policy; stone ID alone is not a durable NPC wallet.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Loads and equips a guardian mace before NPC room placement; guardian still loads if mace allocation fails.
writers.authority_boundary: Bind item UID to guardian lifetime and actual transferability. A failed optional mace load is not proof guardian admission failed.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Materializes a configured nexus stone, assigns logical stone ID/alignment/timers/descriptions and places it in a room.
writers.authority_boundary: Data-backed fixture representation policy required; logical stone ID and runtime object UID have different lifetimes.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Extracts all nexus stone objects after extracting guardians/sages, then reloads configured stones.
writers.authority_boundary: Track replacement lifetimes only under explicit fixture policy; NPC extraction and equipped items require linked lifecycle treatment.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Removes matching guardians/sages and the first matching stone before materializing its configured replacement.
writers.authority_boundary: Logical configuration recovery is not automatically fresh issuance; preserve previous object/NPC lifetime provenance.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Removes guardians/sages and the expired stone, resets alignment and reloads. Flat-file state update precedes teardown; SQL update follows teardown and can fail before replacement.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain actual backend ordering and interrupted replacement outcome. Fixture removal is not proof of completed reset or economic settlement.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Wager calls SUB_MONEY then stores amount and denomination in the live table. Persisted-player SUB_MONEY success means asynchronous submission accepted, but this caller has no stake-commit callback before continuing the round.
writers.authority_boundary: Bind wager debit, table custody and round identity. Submission success cannot prove a funded stake; later payout must not bypass the committed wallet revision. Preserve existing economic policy and document technical failures separately.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: These cash submission/fallback, item allocation/publication and CTF flag movement sites are inside #if 0. They are retained legacy reference, not active reward authority; the CTF branch additionally has its own compile guard.
writers.authority_boundary: Do not claim runtime reward coverage from disabled paths. Re-enabling requires review of original boon completion, payout and flag lifetime linkage.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: For each completed cash entry, submits a separate bank reward using boon ID as reason ID. Immediate rejection reports an error; later rejection reaches the shared fallback callback.
writers.authority_boundary: Original completed-boon identity must bind a deterministic reward child. Boon publication returns before bank completion; acknowledgement of the parent is not proof of cash delivery.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: For each completed item entry, allocates configured vnum and directly publishes it to the player; failed allocation yields no item.
writers.authority_boundary: Bind item UID/payload and durable save acknowledgement to the completed boon and original reward child. Re-entering publication must not allocate duplicate reward objects.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: After committed collection and runtime custody publication, promotes selected object contents to the original parent or room, then extracts only the selected live representation. Failed child relocation can stop partway through live publication.
writers.authority_boundary: Selected UID remains authoritative in collector custody; live extraction is not economic destruction. Preserve children, exact selected-only payload/own weight and original source topology; partial publication requires recovery.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Revision-guarded update installs root, parent, owner and custody state and increments item revision; shared by collection child promotion and selected-item transitions.
writers.authority_boundary: Owning collector transaction determines commit; row update is the custody mutation, not independent creation or destruction.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Appends legacy item ownership evidence under command operation ID and event index with listing provenance and before/after owner revisions.
writers.authority_boundary: Evidence for the same custody transition, not a second item event; common accounting append integration remains unqualified.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Lexical false positive: bank[6] is a local zero-initialized SQL row parsing buffer. SELECT FOR UPDATE supplies bank ID, balances and revision; no durable or live bank balance is written at this coordinate.
writers.authority_boundary: Read/validation prerequisite only. Do not assign a monetary event to buffer initialization; retained as a reviewed route because declaration exclusions currently cover function prototypes only.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Canonicalizes wallet after purchase price, updates player_data and increments wallet and bank revisions, then inserts currency ledger deltas. Bank denominations are unchanged; its revision update is not a bank expense. Legacy opening baselines are inserted if absent.
writers.authority_boundary: Same purchase transaction must link wallet debit, collector listing and item custody. Baseline insertion is not fresh issuance, and legacy ledger evidence alone does not qualify common accounting integration.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Generates an operation ID and submits typed collector work after bounded pending/listing/player checks. Identified and background entry points share the same helper; accepted pending work is not a completed transfer.
writers.authority_boundary: Durable commit and live publication are distinct: callback can carry durable success plus publication error. Preserve original identity and recovery obligations for both actor and background operations.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Builds and queues a typed shop trade with bounded per-player pending state. Completion publishes wallet/bank, custody and shop revision before invoking callback; pending entry is then erased. Covers buy, sell and cleanup payload variants, not an additional purchase at the adapter.
writers.authority_boundary: Queue admission does not prove commit. Callback success combines commit and publication; publication failure must not be treated as proof the backend transaction rolled back.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Listing fees, bid debits and money-claim credits canonicalize the wallet and append legacy currency evidence. Bank revision advances with unchanged denominations. Existing winner pays only the bid increase; a new winner pays the full bid.
writers.authority_boundary: Link wallet leg to fee sink, escrow or consumed claim according to action; baseline/evidence writes are not additional issuance.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Revision-checked root item ownership moves between player and auction, with legacy ownership ledger evidence and both owner revisions advanced.
writers.authority_boundary: One custody transition per root under original operation; ledger append is evidence, not a second movement. Recipient materialization and native save remain separate obligations.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Creates listing and per-slot custody rows containing existing item UIDs, next revisions and captured blob.
writers.authority_boundary: Existing item enters auction custody; inserting a listing/blob does not create another item.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Adds pending money and advances claim revision for displaced bidder refund or seller proceeds after closing fee.
writers.authority_boundary: Retain parent auction/bid identity and distinguish escrow return from seller settlement; pending claim is a holding, not fresh issuance. Aggregate claim arithmetic and replay need qualification.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Sets claim recipient on unclaimed custody slots for winner or returning seller.
writers.authority_boundary: Claim eligibility is separate from custody transfer and live item delivery; preserve existing UID/payload.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Locks positive pending money, applies wallet credit and then zeroes matching claim value while advancing claim revision.
writers.authority_boundary: Same SQL transaction must conserve claim-to-wallet value; clearing the claim is not an independent sink, and replay must not credit twice.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: After matching claimant/revision checks and custody transition, marks each slot claimed with the original command ID and new item revision.
writers.authority_boundary: Receipt consumption proves which command claimed custody, not independently that the native recipient inventory was durably materialized.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Decoder copies a length-checked object blob into a command payload, then validates payload and reconstructed command fences. The coin_bulk_mutation match is a buffer copy, not a coin write. The builder constructs and sorts actor/account, auction and item keys without applying economic state.
writers.authority_boundary: Decode/plan construction only; captured item bytes and reconstructed fences are not issuance, custody movement or admitted work.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Actor and background wrappers share bounded pending admission and generate an operation ID. Completion publishes committed balance/custody; offline actor results wait in the pending map. Publication failure can report false and erase pending after durable commit.
writers.authority_boundary: Accepted queue work is not settlement. Preserve original commit identity and restart-safe publication obligations; callback false does not prove transaction rollback.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Both listing callbacks detach and extract listed live roots after committed custody transfer, then mark player components dirty. Missing or moved roots log an alert and continue.
writers.authority_boundary: Auction retains the item UID: live extraction is not economic destruction. Dirty marking and success message do not prove source save acknowledgement or complete publication.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Both claim callbacks deserialize the shared blob for each result item, overwrite UID with committed identity, attach to player and mark dirty. Deserialize failures alert and skip that child.
writers.authority_boundary: Restoration of an existing claimed holding, not new issuance. Exact per-item payload, repeated publication and durable save acknowledgement remain qualification gaps.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Retained bid definition uses money helper debits/refunds around SQL bid history and previous bidder pickup staging; buy-now invokes current finalize wrapper. Symbol search finds definition only.
writers.authority_boundary: Do not count as active bid integration or assume helper acceptance participates in the surrounding SQL transaction. Original debit/refund provenance required before reactivation.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Retained pickup decrements aggregate claim before separate wallet-credit submission; rejection callback or immediate failure attempts restoration. Item pickup materializes quantity, marks legacy row retrieved and attaches objects; failed load/claim disposes provisional object. Symbol search finds definition only.
writers.authority_boundary: Legacy claim debit and credit are separate boundaries; compensating update and messages do not prove restored value. Temporary failed copies are not destroyed authoritative items; repeated quantity blobs need exact identity policy.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Retained finalize stages seller proceeds after closing fee and legacy item pickup rows, or seller return when no winner. Symbol search finds definition only.
writers.authority_boundary: Original escrow funds proceeds and fee; staging claim is not issuance. Retained definition is not proof of active settlement coverage.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Backfill, resort and info deserialize temporary objects to compute metadata or display identification, then extract them. Backfill is retained tooling; resort/info are command paths.
writers.authority_boundary: Temporary catalog representations do not move listing custody or issue/destroy holdings. Allocation side effects and cleanup remain distinct from economic delivery.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Persisted PCs route put and PC give to compound coin commands. Remaining drop/give submits wallet_spend then callback publishes or compensates; nonpersisted/NPC actor uses SUB_MONEY and synchronous callback.
writers.authority_boundary: Dispatch semantics differ by actor and destination. Wallet debit acceptance alone is not completed transfer; retain original identity and actual transient holding policy.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Merges denominations into an existing transient pile via add_coins or creates a provisional pile, temporarily attaches to actor, and invokes put. Failed put extracts the provisional object. PC-corpse wrapper subsequently calls writeCorpse.
writers.authority_boundary: Post-debit publication is not independent issuance. Existing pile value mutation is semantic evidence even when this scanner misses that add_coins call; writeCorpse invocation alone does not prove durable acknowledgement.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Builds before/after denomination and custody snapshot for pile creation, change or consumption. add_coins renders descriptions on a temporary object; item command construction does not mutate the live pile.
writers.authority_boundary: New/consumed pile shell lifetime and transferred money are distinct linked facts. Temporary rendering is not issuance or a live balance change.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Revision-checked committed pile publication removes consumed piles, discards detached copies for offline owners, or restores exact UID and attaches it to its container. Newer revisions suppress stale publication; live denomination copy and description update project the committed result.
writers.authority_boundary: Consumption is linked to transferred value, while offline detached cleanup is not economic destruction. Hydration/materialization must not be counted again as issuance; save and restart qualification remain separate.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Rejected coin put completion extracts a newly created still-detached pile; successful result instead publishes the committed destination endpoint.
writers.authority_boundary: Cleanup of a never-admitted candidate, not value destruction. Failed committed publication remains unresolved rather than permission to refund or reissue blindly.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Missing runtime custody triggers an absent-item movement with the same source/destination. Admission callback rechecks UID, container, outer location and owner before continuing pickup. Failed continuation leaves the admitted pile available and does not credit a wallet.
writers.authority_boundary: Existing pile admission is separate from pickup; absence from runtime registry does not prove fresh economic issuance. Preserve source provenance and original lifetime; admission replay must not mint coins.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: PC money pickup returns through submit_coin_get. Remaining NPC branch clears pile denomination values, computes int copper total, calls ADD_MONEY and detaches/extracts the pile. Retained notall display/description branch is guarded by a local initialized to zero and never assigned again in this function.
writers.authority_boundary: NPC pile-to-live-wallet transfer needs explicit holding/lifetime policy; do not model extraction as independent sink. Arithmetic/refusal outcomes and scanner-missed value[] writes must be reviewed; no durable NPC wallet is proven here.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: PC durable pickup submits source-to-player movement using locker/corpse/get reason. Tracked NPC pickup submits a same-owner mobile_claim boundary before live handoff, leaving room/corpse authority rather than inventing persistent NPC inventory.
writers.authority_boundary: Preserve exact source, selected subtree, claimant and actual authority policy; a live handoff or mobile_claim is not evidence of new durable NPC ownership.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Condition-zero pickup invokes MakeScrap and returns before normal item/coin transfer submission.
writers.authority_boundary: Source retirement and any scrap helper output need linked input/output identities; failed pickup is not automatically no economic change.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Only alive trusted characters pass entry guard. Junk rejects artifacts; ordinary item destruction rewards ten copper, while visible nontransient bulk items invoke an additional ten-copper ADD_MONEY before destruction. Transient items dissolve without reward.
writers.authority_boundary: Preserve current bulk/single/visibility economics explicitly, including two reward calls for visible bulk items. Link retired item/container subtree to reward children; asynchronous reward acceptance is not durable completion and must not silently change reward policy.

writers.authority_boundary: Source availability and each selected root are rechecked between adoption callbacks. Earlier source admissions can remain committed if the final pickup fails; they are not player delivery or proof of fresh issuance. Durable forest publication and deferred coin pickups are distinct operations.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Selected scrap invokes MakeScrap after bulk durable pickup completion, with source revalidation; selected coin piles separately continue through bounded coin pickup.
writers.authority_boundary: Scrapping and coin continuation are outside the preceding durable forest transfer. Ordinary source proximity is required, with a stable original-room corpse exception for selected coins. Do not claim command-wide atomicity.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Select durable inventory roots and submit one custody batch to the resolved destination; with no durable roots, synchronous candidates run directly.
writers.authority_boundary: Completion requires actor still in original room and all durable roots still carried before publication. Committed failure erases live batch state and alerts; that does not undo custody or establish recovery. Synchronous candidates are scanned from current inventory afterwards.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Coins, unowned transient objects and PC corpse roots move from inventory to room outside generic durable batch custody. Room insertion can merge and free a money object.
writers.authority_boundary: Post-batch synchronous selection uses then-current inventory and filter, not the durable root snapshot. Floor hints and corpse writes are not save receipts; merged live pile representation must not be mistaken for economic destruction.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Give branches outside distinct-PC durable transfer and CMD_GIVE durable pet routing detach and attach synchronously, then log, mark PC components and invoke give hooks. Pet routing requires known matching source custody and controlled durable pet identity.
writers.authority_boundary: CMD_GIVE gating is material: do not infer all internal command variants or NPC transfers use durable custody. Insertion can crumble/extract an item; existing comment identifies subsequent pointer use as deferred risk. Dirty marking and hooks do not prove save acknowledgement.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Weight adjustment temporarily detaches and reinserts the same carried, worn or nested item to update aggregate effects; room items adjust weight directly. Intended owner is unchanged.
writers.authority_boundary: This is not fresh issuance or an intended owner transfer. Invalid wearer recovery can set LOC_NOWHERE; reinsertion and equipment helpers can have their own effects, so same-owner intent does not prove harmless publication or durable payload persistence.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: After drinking effects and liquid decrement, an owned empty transient drink container is detached and extracted. Ordinary empty containers remain with cleared liquid/poison fields.
writers.authority_boundary: Liquid payload updates and final container retirement must be distinguished. Gameplay effects precede extraction; no compound commit or native save acknowledgement is established here.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Non-NPC eating consumes a carried item after eligibility/effect checks; privileged actors may eat non-food and optionally clear artifact registry. Level mushroom advances level and attempts silent save before extraction.
writers.authority_boundary: Mushroom consumption proceeds even when save reports failure. Other food effects and optional artifact clear precede extraction; neither path demonstrates atomic benefit-and-retirement or acknowledged item saving. Preserve existing privileged behavior rather than silently changing economics.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Move an existing carried item to an equipment slot, using common wear helper or direct wrist/belt branches. Wrist slots depend on anatomy; belt attachments require an equipped belt and available attachment slot.
writers.authority_boundary: Same actor retains intended ownership; equipped placement and effects change. Wear controller refuses items not yet carried, including detached pending creation grants. Helper execution does not prove durable slot saving or eliminate equipment side effects.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Move worn item back to the same character inventory. Removing waist item first returns up to three belt attachments; removes holy sword/permanent invisibility/enchantment effects as applicable.
writers.authority_boundary: Initial carry capacity check precedes all attachment removals. Each nested unequip/insert is a live step, not proof of atomic equipment group persistence. Source explicitly defers potential pointer use after insertion crumble; preserve as unqualified behavior.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Wear of a carried item with nonpositive condition invokes MakeScrap and refuses ordinary equip.
writers.authority_boundary: This is item conversion/retirement via MakeScrap rather than successful wear; distinguish resulting scrap from original item identity and do not infer issuance from the wear attempt.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Consume liquid quantity and weight while setting weapon poison payload; empty transient poison container is detached and extracted. Selection accepts inventory or belt-attached containers.
writers.authority_boundary: Weapon benefit, liquid depletion and container retirement are separate live mutations with no demonstrated compound save receipt. The final detach uses obj_from_char even for belt selection; helper behavior must be qualified, not assumed equivalent.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Catalog diagnostic loops over vnums using read_object and logs food properties; no gameplay placement or extraction appears in this function.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Revalidate selected container contents and committed destination graph before moving them to target. Failed insertion attempts restore moved and remaining objects to source and undo counted quiver increments.
writers.authority_boundary: Live rollback does not undo committed custody. Completion returns false and retains operation state on publication failure; success marks dirty and requests storage saves before clearing state. This is not proof of restart-safe retention or native save acknowledgement.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Selected durable container roots submit a batch with destination parent and publication callback; entirely synchronous selections call the same publication helper without custody submission.
writers.authority_boundary: Selection tracks exact UIDs and pointers, graph counts, source/destination authority and capacity. Durable and synchronous roots share live publication but SQL commit and native save acknowledgement remain distinct; refusal before submission and publication failure after commit must not be conflated.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Select durable roots under cumulative capacity constraints and submit one resolved container custody batch. Completion revalidates source carriage and destination/capacity, then calls put under acknowledgement guard.
writers.authority_boundary: Publication refusal can follow earlier live insertions and clears batch state without undoing committed custody. Remaining pass skips exactly batch-claimed UIDs and may submit newly durable candidates separately; it counts only actual live insertion, not put return alone. No command-wide atomicity or save receipt is established.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: After defer_durable_put either bypasses or acknowledges submission, move existing item from character or room into quiver/container/storage/corpse. Carried quiver insertion increments count; carried ordinary insertion adjusts optional space.
writers.authority_boundary: Same helpers serve acknowledged and synchronous paths. Room fallback has distinct count/space handling and its reachability is not proven by an old comment. Dirty marks, logging and storage write requests are not native save acknowledgement; destination nesting is economic topology rather than issuance.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Trusted get nowhere scans object_list for missing or invalid location representations, forces LOC_NOWHERE and inserts existing objects into the trusted character inventory.
writers.authority_boundary: Recovery does not establish fresh issuance or rightful ownership. This bypasses ordinary pickup submission and needs explicit reconciliation against retained authority; pending detached objects must not be assumed abandoned merely from live location.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Named-all and all drop paths for non-PC actors move live carried items to room; PCs return earlier through bulk drop. Named-all rejects soulbound items while the shown ordinary-all branch checks nodrop/trust.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Single-item drop moves directly from character to room after restrictions when the PC durable-ownership branch does not apply. This includes NPCs and excluded ownership classes.
writers.authority_boundary: Room insertion, floor hints, dirty marks and corpse save invocation are distinct from acknowledged custody. Potential pile merging means live-copy disappearance is not necessarily value destruction; no transactional receipt is established here.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Sector-specific random prototype allocation followed by optional poison payload adjustment and insertion into forager inventory. Forest, swamp, field, hills, mountain, underworld and desert tables preserve distinct existing distributions.

No allocation-null guard or durable receipt is demonstrated in this helper; messages after insertion do not establish saving or replay safety. Preserve random outcome and poison payload on retry rather than issuing again.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Scribing/memorizing forage creates a temporary prototype solely for a doodle message, then extracts it without placement.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: After regular forage fails, a successful giant-specific terrain roll creates prototype 20 and places it in the room; ordinary successful forage instead calls forage_sect.
writers.authority_boundary: New tree is issued to room rather than player inventory. Preserve source attempt and selected outcome for retry; live placement/messages and wait state are not durable admission receipts.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Legacy quit lower-level branch unequips and destroys transient items or drops other items before terminal character save. Nodrop tests are commented out. Higher-level branch retains items.
writers.authority_boundary: Source says normal quit routes to camp and mortal quit is restricted; these sites are compiled behavior, not proven ordinary gameplay reachability. Terminal save failure leaves prior live mutations applied. No compound custody/retirement/save boundary is established.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

No paired commit or failure compensation is demonstrated here; bind both owners, selected denominations and original theft attempt rather than recording the credit as a new reward. NPC authority and persistence of each endpoint require qualification.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Quaff consumes a carried/held potion on combat spill, epic gain, lethal self-damage or normal spell processing. Held potion is unequipped after spill check; no-magic room still consumes.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Only begin_device_action legacy result enters this branch. Held scroll is unequipped, spells are attempted and scroll extracted normally or when caster/target disappears; no-magic and rejected spell targets can still consume it.

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.classification: Hide removes room objects matching tracks prototype before final hiding outcome.
writers.authority_boundary: Environmental representation cleanup is not automatically player asset destruction; classify track admission/lifetime and descendants explicitly. No accounting receipt demonstrated.
writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified

writers.current_support: Existing behavior only; accounting integration unverified
